evidence: Changes error handling across all secondary indexes (`src/index/txindex`, `coinstatsindex`, `blockfilterindex`, and `txospenderindex`) so point-read and deserialization corruptions trigger fatal aborts.
rationale: Prevents secondary indexes from silently treating corrupted database records as non-existent keys or failing individual RPCs while continuing to run in a damaged state. Data integrity is the top priority in indexes, though the approach of taking down the node on optional index corruption is contested in review.
